themes.name: Clinic linen
themes.title: Ward Initiative
themes.look: Soft teal accent, plenty of whitespace, clinical and calm. Keep the three panes.
themes.subtitle: Notes from a conversation with a hospital IT lead.
themes.placeholder: e.g. 320 Windows laptops, clinical staff sharing devices…
themes.sample:
Customer has 320 Windows laptops, most are four years old.
Support volumes have increased and clinical staff share devices.
They are concerned about patient data leaving the organisation.
themes.say: They've got about three hundred Windows laptops, most of them four years old. The help desk is drowning. And they're nervous about patient data leaving the building.

themes.name: Lecture hall
themes.title: Campus Mac Brief
themes.look: University navy accent, gold-tinted priority badge, slightly more formal type. Keep the three panes.
themes.subtitle: Notes from a conversation with a university IT director.
themes.placeholder: e.g. 2,400 student Windows laptops, exam-week crash…
themes.sample:
Faculty of 2,400 student Windows laptops. Machines lock up in exam week.
Shared lab PCs, no one owns a device. IT is two people for the whole campus.
They will not put student work or exam scripts in a US cloud.
themes.say: Two thousand student Windows laptops, they die in exam week. The labs are shared, nobody owns a machine. And they will not put exam scripts in a cloud in another country.

themes.name: Shop floor
themes.title: Floor Brief
themes.look: Punchy retail red, compact cards, energetic. Keep the three panes.
themes.subtitle: Notes from a conversation with a retail operations lead.
themes.placeholder: e.g. 180 till PCs, four-year-old, stockroom Wi-Fi dies…
themes.sample:
180 till PCs, most four years old, freeze during Saturday peak.
Staff share logins. Training videos live on a USB stick behind the counter.
Head office wants customer receipts processed in the store, not sent to a vendor cloud.
themes.say: A hundred and eighty till PCs, they freeze every Saturday. Staff share one login. And they want receipts staying in the store, not going off to some vendor's cloud.

themes.name: Trading floor
themes.title: Desk Brief
themes.look: Deep green accent, dense information, serious. Keep the three panes.
themes.subtitle: Notes from a conversation with a bank workplace lead.
themes.placeholder: e.g. 900 trading Windows boxes, seven years old…
themes.sample:
900 trading-floor Windows boxes, seven years old, loud and hot.
Compliance will not let research notes leave the building.
They need a silent machine that can summarise a term sheet without touching the internet.
themes.say: Nine hundred trading boxes, seven years old, they sound like hairdryers. Research notes cannot leave the building. They want something quiet that can summarise a term sheet with the network off.

themes.name: Kitchen pass
themes.title: Service Brief
themes.look: Warm copper accent, rounded corners, inviting. Keep the three panes.
themes.subtitle: Notes from a conversation with a hotel group ops manager.
themes.placeholder: e.g. 60 front-desk PCs, greasy keyboards, guest names…
themes.sample:
60 front-desk PCs across four hotels, keyboards you wouldn't touch.
Night staff write guest preferences on paper because the old PMS is slow.
Guest passport scans must never go to a third-party cloud.
themes.say: Sixty front-desk PCs, you would not want to type on them. Night staff still write guest notes on paper. Passport scans cannot go to a third-party cloud.

themes.name: Newsroom
themes.title: Desk File
themes.look: Ink and yellow, high contrast, newsroom energy. Keep the three panes.
themes.subtitle: Notes from a conversation with a newsroom systems editor.
themes.sample:
120 reporter Windows laptops. Embargoed copy has leaked twice from a cloud doc.
Editors want a machine that transcribes an interview in the field with the radios off.
Legal will not approve any tool that sends audio off-device.
themes.say: A hundred and twenty reporter laptops. Embargoed copy leaked from a cloud doc, twice. They want to transcribe an interview in a car park with the radios off. Legal will not sign off anything that sends the audio away.

themes.name: Workshop bay
themes.title: Bay Brief
themes.look: Industrial orange, sturdy layout, large tap targets. Keep the three panes.
themes.subtitle: Notes from a conversation with a plant IT lead.
themes.placeholder: e.g. 40 rugged Windows boxes on the line…
themes.sample:
40 rugged Windows boxes on the line, gloves on, they hate the tiny UI.
Work instructions are PDFs on a shared drive that drops when the forklift goes by.
Process data and photos of defects must stay on the shop floor.
themes.say: Forty rugged boxes on the line. People have gloves on and they hate the tiny buttons. The PDF instructions drop out when a forklift goes past. Defect photos have to stay on the shop floor.

themes.name: Chambers
themes.title: Matter Brief
themes.look: Burgundy accent, conservative spacing, quiet confidence. Keep the three panes.
themes.subtitle: Notes from a conversation with a chambers practice manager.
themes.sample:
70 counsel laptops. Privilege notes currently live in personal Gmail.
They want dictation of a conference that never leaves the Mac.
The Bar Council will not accept a US SaaS holding client files.
themes.say: Seventy counsel laptops. Privilege notes are in personal Gmail, which is mad. They want to dictate a conference that never leaves the Mac. The Bar Council will not accept a US company holding the files.

themes.name: Lab bench
themes.title: Lab Brief
themes.look: Violet accent, precise layout, a bit of lab-coat polish. Keep the three panes.
themes.subtitle: Notes from a conversation with a biotech lab manager.
themes.placeholder: e.g. 25 bench PCs, ELN in the cloud, GxP…
themes.sample:
25 Windows PCs on the bench. The ELN is in a US cloud and QA is unhappy.
Scientists photograph gel trays on personal phones.
Anything with patient-derived samples has to stay on-prem.
themes.say: Twenty-five bench PCs. The notebook is in a US cloud and QA hates it. People photograph gels on their phones. Patient-derived samples cannot leave the building.

themes.name: Depot
themes.title: Yard Brief
themes.look: Sky-blue accent, big type, readable at a glance. Keep the three panes.
themes.subtitle: Notes from a conversation with a depot operations lead.
themes.placeholder: e.g. 90 dispatcher PCs, night shift, POD photos…
themes.sample:
90 dispatcher PCs, night shift, the monitors are ancient.
Proof-of-delivery photos go to a driver's WhatsApp.
Customer addresses cannot be processed by a cloud model in another region.
themes.say: Ninety dispatcher PCs, night shift, the screens belong in a museum. Proof of delivery is going to WhatsApp. Customer addresses cannot be processed by a model in another country.
